item.description:
Pick up goes straight to your agent in tmux and Warp
- An agent in a tmux pane opens in your tmux client, and a reply goes straight into its pane - Claude Code installed with npm is found running, so Pick up in Warp goes to its tab instead of starting a second copy - A session waiting on helpers or a command it left in the background stays at work until they report back - A helper's own steps no longer clear the question the session is asking you - A checkout with thousands of changes no longer leaves the list on "Looking for your sessions" - A quick hello in a terminal stays in the list while its agent is open

Allowing Accessibility finds Perch in the list
- Allow lets macOS's own prompt open System Settings, with Perch already there: choose Open System Settings in it, then switch Perch on

Perch is now signed and notarized by Apple
- macOS asks for Accessibility once more after this update. Allow is right here, and Command+Option works again the moment it is on - Downloads open without a security warning, and updates install the same way - If Accessibility is ever turned off, the notch says so once, with Allow - New session takes attachments, and the agent and folder you picked hold still while other sessions work - Selecting text in a reply or a new session's prompt shows a highlight, Command+A included - A session at work no longer brings back a question you already left behind
